findings.message: singleton 'Resolver' resolves transient IDisposable 'Conn' by hand from its injected root IServiceProvider (GetService/GetRequiredService — the service-locator anti-pattern): the root provider tracks every IDisposable it resolves and frees them only at application shutdown, so each call leaks a transient that should be scope-lived — resolve it from an IServiceScope instead (Resolver -> Conn) [singleton registered at reg.cs:5]
